description: Swaps a domain's check, tightens it to NOT NULL and gives it a default, all while a column is typed by it. None of the three has an excuse to recreate the domain, so all three have to alter it in place.

sqlserver.because: SQL Server's alias types carry no check constraint, so the scenario's bootstrap state cannot be expressed.

sqlite.because: SQLite has no domain type, so the scenario's bootstrap state cannot be expressed.
